$comment: Platform preference (card xx0055i). fix.roundCapAction person|takeover: at the fix round cap, takeover = dispatch ONE takeover fix (full round history, top claude rung of the fixer ladder) before asking the operator; person = ask the operator at once (tool override env WE_FIX_ROUND_CAP_ACTION). fix.roundHistory on|off: a round N>1 fix brief carries the previous-rounds section (env WE_FIX_ROUND_HISTORY). fix.takeoverBudget: how many automatic takeovers one PR may get, 0 turns the takeover off, an invalid value fails closed to 0; a further one runs only when the previous one reduced the open findings, else the operator gets a takeover-not-converging note; gate holds (stacked base, review:human hold) never trigger one (cascade: standard 2 -> platform preference scripts/lib/delivery-platform-preferences.json fix.takeoverBudget -> this file -> env WE_FIX_TAKEOVER_BUDGET; see scripts/conveyor/takeover-budget.mjs). Ruling disputes always go to the operator. Card xrbu1bp: fix.resumeAcrossRounds on|off: round N>1 resumes the previous round's fixer session when it is still resumable and its lane is still at the PR head (else a cold start with the history brief; env WE_FIX_RESUME_ACROSS_ROUNDS). fix.strongerModelFromRound: from this round an ordinary fix runs on the fixer ladder's stronger-model rung, 0 = off (env WE_FIX_STRONGER_MODEL_FROM_ROUND). fix.operatorRulingExtraRounds: how many directed takeovers one operator ruling (every blocked finding ruled block with a direction) buys past the round cap, standard 1, 0 = off, an invalid value fails closed to 0 (env WE_FIX_OPERATOR_RULING_EXTRA_ROUNDS; set it under this file's fix key like the others); it also needs fix.roundCapAction=takeover and a fix.takeoverBudget above 0, so those two off switches stop it too (see scripts/conveyor/reconcile-core.mjs#resolveOperatorRulingExtraRounds). See scripts/conveyor/fix-takeover.mjs, scripts/conveyor/fix-round-history.mjs and scripts/conveyor/fix-resume.mjs. fix.loopHold.redMainDiscount on|off (default on; env WE_FIX_LOOP_RED_MAIN_DISCOUNT): repair sessions during red-main windows do not consume either loop budget, and parks caused only by those attempts lapse once main recovers. fix.owedCiRerun {rerun: on|off, maxRerunsPerHead: integer >= 0} mechanically re-runs failed required jobs once main is green, standard on with 1 re-run per head (env WE_FIX_OWED_CI_RERUN; cascade env > this file > standard). fix.staleCiRerun off|once-per-head (standard once-per-head; env WE_FIX_STALE_CI_RERUN; cascade env > this file > standard, logged each pass): a red required check not explained by a red main window still gets ONE mechanical re-run of its failed jobs per head while main is green and nothing on the head is still running; off keeps the old path (timeout re-run only, else ci-heal).
